headline: 842-function contribution brings USA v1.01 matched code to 65.83%
summary: Contributors can now work from 842 more reconstructed C functions carried over from bigbeno37's fork in #368, covering boot and level code. USA v1.01 ends the day at 7,100 of 8,578 matched functions and 3,637,728 of 5,525,780 code bytes, or 65.83%; matching means compiling to exactly the original game's bytes. The final progress commit also records 6,646 of 8,634 functions for USA v2.00 and 4,979 of 8,672 for PAL.
highlights: #367's earlier report recorded matched code at 54.81% for USA v1.01, 32.09% for USA v2.00 and 17.49% for PAL, before #368 landed; these are intermediate figures.
#364 adds 21 primary matches; #366 retains 15 reviewed contributor matches, including level work around Todano, Aranos prison and Endako, while keeping disputed work as near misses.
#368 dominates the day's line counts: 73,572 additions and 59,161 deletions out of totals of 105,041 and 68,398.
Parallel builds now use a Wine prefix per active program to avoid one wineserver bottleneck. #369 corrects Fully linked code accounting to sum complete units.
#362 retains a 212-byte near miss with differing pointer registers, not an exact match. #370 and #371 opened object-slot and held-object reconstructions without merge events today.
